items.title: Future of Food
items.keywords: Cultivated Meat · Alternative Protein · Cellular Agriculture · FoodTech
items.description: Science is moving quickly. Commercialisation is harder. Parul speaks about what it will take to move cultivated meat and alternative proteins from laboratories into viable industries: regulation, scale-up, economics, infrastructure, consumer adoption and India's opportunity.
talks: From Lab to Market: What It Will Take to Build the Future of Food
Cultivated Meat: Beyond the Hype
Can India Build a Future-of-Food Industry?
Alternative Protein: Where Science Meets Commercial Reality

items.title: AI & the Future of Operations
items.description: AI creates value only when technology, process and economics come together. Parul brings a business lens to AI, automation and the future of operating models.
talks: AI Beyond the Model
When Should a Business Actually Automate?
Redesigning the Operating Model Around AI
Technology Selection Is Not Operating-Model Design

items.title: Supply Chains
items.description: Supply chains reveal whether a business is truly ready to scale. Drawing from experience across logistics, e-commerce and large operating systems, Parul speaks about designing supply chains that work beyond the PowerPoint.
talks: Building Supply Chains That Can Survive Scale
What E-commerce Taught Us About the Future of Logistics
From Last Mile to Business Model
Resilient Supply Chains Are Designed, Not Discovered

items.title: MSMEs & Business Transformation
items.description: Many MSMEs don't need another strategy deck. They need stronger operating systems. Parul speaks about moving from founder-dependent execution to process-led, technology-enabled, scalable organisations.
talks: From Founder-Led to System-Led
Why MSME Transformation Is an Operating Problem
Technology Is Not Digital Transformation
Building Businesses That Can Grow Without Breaking

items.title: Women in Business & Supply Chain
items.description: Women's participation is not only a leadership conversation. It's an economic and ecosystem question. Parul speaks about representation, professional networks, leadership pipelines and the systems that enable more women to participate and progress.
talks: Where Are the Women in Supply Chain?
Participation Before Leadership
Building Professional Ecosystems for Women
Moving From Representation to Economic Opportunity

items.title: Policy × Industry × Innovation
items.description: New industries can't scale through entrepreneurship alone. They need policy, regulation, capital, infrastructure, talent and industry to move together. Parul speaks about how emerging sectors become functioning ecosystems.
talks: Who Builds an Industry Before the Industry Exists?
The Missing Infrastructure Behind Emerging Innovation
Regulation as an Enabler of New Markets
Building India's Next Industry Ecosystems
